hypothesis: The uniform threshold preserves strong stage-one ranking and positive loss contrasts but admits a later-stage population on which the frozen gate score is nearly rank-neutral. Stricter stage-one and stage-two thresholds can restrict later decisions to higher-confidence subsets while preserving complete counterfactual paths.
